				<div class="hotel_name">Rancho Do Peixe</div>
				<div class="hotels_address">
										<div class="location_text_mobile">
						Rua da Praia, S/N Praia do Preá Cruz
					</div>
					<div class="location_maps">See on Map</div>
				</div>

						<div class="hotel_description">
				<div class="hotel_description_short">
					Located on Praia do Preá (a quiet fishing village) 25 minutes from Jericoacoara (12 km), Pousada Rancho do Peixe offers 26 exclusive bungalows with charm, comfort and privacy. It was considered by Tri<span class="hotel_description_more">Read more</span>
				</div>
				<div class="hotel_description_long">
					Located on Praia do Preá (a quiet fishing village) 25 minutes from Jericoacoara (12 km), Pousada Rancho do Peixe offers 26 exclusive bungalows with charm, comfort and privacy. It was considered by Trip Advisor one of the best hotels in Brazil as well as gain 2 times consecutive the Seal Condé Nast International. It is an ideal refuge for those who are looking for rest and direct contact with nature besides having contact with sailing sports. We offer free 4x transfer a day to Jeri so that customers can stay in the tranquility of the pray and can go to the busy Jeri. Pousada bungalows were fully built from local materials and decorated with handmade products. Rustic decoration values ​​the environment and local characteristics, as well as the work and culture of the natives .. Such concerns reflect one of the main philosophies of the fish ranch, sustainability. We believe and practice actions that make a difference and contribute to integrated development with the community. Separation and recycling of garbage, realization of awareness campaigns, buildings with reforestation wood and carnauba straw are just a few of our actions. An organic vegetable garden in a mandala format aims to provide quality of life, generate economic productivity and seek environmental balance with responsibility, as well as promoting the exercise of citizenship in the region. Fruits, vegetables and vegetables are planted to be served in the restaurant itself .. Accommodations were designed so that natural ventilation dispenses the use of air conditioning. That is, enabling the guest to easily adapt to the environment and enjoy an authentic experience among nature. The private decks are equipped with networks, some of the bungalows situated near the coqueiral and others facing a fascinating view of Preá Beach and its beautiful sunset. Among the other facilities, the hostel offers a relaxing space with various types of massage and treatments, a restaurant focused on regional gastronomy, a bar and a refreshing pool of 25 meters. The fish ranch also features a Kitesurf school called Rancho do Kite, which has guarderia for its equipment, qualified professionals to minister the courses and equipment rental. After all, good winds make the beach of preach the ideal place for kitesurfing practice. All the accommodation of the enterprise were developed to follow the philosophy of generating experiences to our guests, with comfort and excellent service, formatting to the environment and culture of the region ..
				</div>
			</div>

            <div class="mobile_hotel_description_holder">
            <p class="mobile_hotel_description_title">About the Hotel</p>
            <div class="mobile_hotel_description_long">
                Located on Praia do Preá (a quiet fishing village) 25 minutes from Jericoacoara (12 km), Pousada Rancho do Peixe offers 26 exclusive bungalows with charm, comfort and privacy. It was considered by Trip Advisor one of the best hotels in Brazil as well as gain 2 times consecutive the Seal Condé Nast International. It is an ideal refuge for those who are looking for rest and direct contact with nature besides having contact with sailing sports. We offer free 4x transfer a day to Jeri so that customers can stay in the tranquility of the pray and can go to the busy Jeri. Pousada bungalows were fully built from local materials and decorated with handmade products. Rustic decoration values ​​the environment and local characteristics, as well as the work and culture of the natives .. Such concerns reflect one of the main philosophies of the fish ranch, sustainability. We believe and practice actions that make a difference and contribute to integrated development with the community. Separation and recycling of garbage, realization of awareness campaigns, buildings with reforestation wood and carnauba straw are just a few of our actions. An organic vegetable garden in a mandala format aims to provide quality of life, generate economic productivity and seek environmental balance with responsibility, as well as promoting the exercise of citizenship in the region. Fruits, vegetables and vegetables are planted to be served in the restaurant itself .. Accommodations were designed so that natural ventilation dispenses the use of air conditioning. That is, enabling the guest to easily adapt to the environment and enjoy an authentic experience among nature. The private decks are equipped with networks, some of the bungalows situated near the coqueiral and others facing a fascinating view of Preá Beach and its beautiful sunset. Among the other facilities, the hostel offers a relaxing space with various types of massage and treatments, a restaurant focused on regional gastronomy, a bar and a refreshing pool of 25 meters. The fish ranch also features a Kitesurf school called Rancho do Kite, which has guarderia for its equipment, qualified professionals to minister the courses and equipment rental. After all, good winds make the beach of preach the ideal place for kitesurfing practice. All the accommodation of the enterprise were developed to follow the philosophy of generating experiences to our guests, with comfort and excellent service, formatting to the environment and culture of the region ..
            </div>
        </div>
